section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the Oregon Vocational Interest Scales (ORVIS), a public-domain self-report measure of vocational interests. It consists of 92 items designed to measure eight dimensions of vocational interests, including leadership, organization, altruism, creativity, analysis, producing, adventuring, and erudition. No specific studies or experiments are detailed in this text.
